posts.zh:
dsh-model-picker 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Web UI 模型选择器替换插件：对话框式选择，支持模糊搜索、供应商折叠分组、收藏与只看收藏过滤，以及思考档位下拉，复用官方组件库与 DSW 设计 token。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d5dbfc1f59a28c4b261b.html
posts.en:
dsh-model-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Dialog-style model picker for the DSH Web UI: fuzzy search, collapsible provider groups, favorites with a favorites-only filter, and a thinking-level dropdown, replacing the built-in model selector with official UI primitives and DSW tokens.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-d5dbfc1f59a28c4b261b.html
